title: We did a walking tour of...
text: We did a walking tour of old town and the gothic quarter.  It was a great experience!  Sandra was our tour guide and she was very knowledgeable.  She took the time to understand what our interests were and tailored the content around it.  We had a wonderful time and learned so much more than we would’ve just walking around on our own and reading about what we saw.  The price was very reasonable, as well.  Definitely worth it!!
author: Tim_R
